name: 24013-imageprefill-qwen3vl8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct -- ungated, ~16 GB of bf16 safetensors.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, no quantization_config; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% (both mode=requests), bounded at 512 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm, single-turn chat: one fresh 1920x1080 gradient JPEG at quality 85 plus 256 text tokens per request, 32 output tokens with ignore_eos. Every image is distinct.
purpose: An image-and-text chat assistant answering questions about full-HD photos with brief replies for 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang 0.5.16 launch arguments.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
mem-fraction-static: 0.7
chunked-prefill-size: 16384

# HAZARD: `fa3` resolves to a prebuilt kernel fetched from the kernels-community hub on FIRST
# USE, falling back to sgl_kernel's own build if the fetch fails, so the first requests can pay
# a download or a compile. Warm up before anything is read off the run.
mm-attention-backend: fa3

disable-radix-cache: true
random-seed: 42
